performance.verdict: Spend intentionally throttled; intake gap blocks scaling — GHL leak confirmed.

findings.text: Lead tracking shows 0 leads over 28 days despite 12 Google Ads conversions and 28 GBP calls — CPL is uncalculable due to a tracking/intake disconnect, not zero demand.
Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 and has no completed event recorded — CRM speed-to-lead automation status is unknown 26 days past deadline.
GHL shows 43 opportunities created but 0 appointments and value $0 — leads arriving but not converting to bookings signals an active intake leak, not an ads problem.

3-day spend signal (Aug 23–25: $62.48, $16.46, $15.83) vs prior 3 days (Aug 20–22: $16.06, $21.63, $84.70) shows erratic, low daily pacing at $31.70/day — intentional throttle is holding but pacing is uneven.
GBP actions dropped to 0 for 3 consecutive days (Aug 23–25) after a spike of 17 on Aug 19 — possible Windsor data lag per SOW caveat, but warrants watching.

suggestions.text: Confirm who owns GHL intake post-Vivian departure; verify login active and speed-to-lead automation firing — 43 opps, 0 appointments.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and no confirmed replacement GHL seat has been validated. GHL shows 43 opportunities created but 0 appointments and $0 pipeline value over 28 days — leads are entering the CRM but not being booked. Action: confirm the current intake owner, verify their GHL login is active, and test that the speed-to-lead automation triggers correctly on a new contact. Success is confirmed when at least one appointment is logged in GHL within 7 days of this fix, by 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Battle-test the booking bot immediately — due 2026-07-31, now 26 days overdue; unverified automation blocks any budget scale-up.
